summary: Measure slow chat and provider paths without changing their behavior. Main and renderer share monotonic timing thresholds; chat history responses add optional diagnostic timing fields, and a local script summarizes persisted spans. Review fixes preserve span ownership across concurrent sends, distinguish failed history loads from empty chats, validate the committed array at paint, and discover desktop/headless logs across platforms.

reactNativeIos.reason: No phone UI or chat-open instrumentation is added. Optional timing and loadStatus history fields are ignored by existing phone clients; server-side request measurements apply to phone calls.

nativeAndroid.reason: No Android UI or native code changes. Optional timing and loadStatus history fields are ignored by existing Android clients; server-side request measurements apply to phone calls.

storageDataMigration.reason: Timing is diagnostic metadata in existing rotating log files and optional response fields. No persisted conversation setting, database schema, migration or transcript content changes.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, native dependency, signing, deep link, OTA runtime, release channel or packaging changes. Optional timing and loadStatus metadata is backward compatible with existing desktop and phone clients; older backends without loadStatus remain supported.

automated: Vitest fake-clock threshold and span tests, summary parser/percentile tests, slow IPC behavior tests, and chat commit/frame lifecycle tests.
Root typecheck and full vitest gate.

Round 2 regression tests cover rejected/throwing concurrent submissions, originless send retries, failed/empty history responses, pre-paint replacements, platform log paths, missing directories, other filesystem failures, explicit filenames and aliased log directories.
notExercised: No real provider accounts, phone hardware, production timing session or network deployment exercised.
React commit duration logging skipped: production Profiler is unavailable and component-function timers do not measure full React commits.
No visual baselines changed: no markup, styling or visible behavior changes.
Summary CLI exercised on macOS with private fixtures. Windows/Linux data-path rules are unit-tested; no desktop binaries or hardware on those platforms were exercised.
